projects.title: Robot Operator HMI
projects.summary: The production control app for a wearable UMI humanoid teleoperation suit. I led it from implementation through deployment. It runs operator workflows and shows system status.
highlights: Suit operation, readiness checks, OTA updates, and accessible audio controls.
MCAP demonstration recording, episode tracking, and storage and upload status for humanoid fine-manipulation training data.
Tactile-sensor and encoder diagnostics that block recording when pre-session hardware checks fail.
Teleop console features: a live network-latency view, log annotation, VR and keyboard shortcuts, and safer exit and reset.

projects.title: Fleet Operations Dashboard
projects.summary: A production dashboard that puts a robot fleet in one view. Built with Next.js and React.
highlights: Combines robot inventory, heartbeat and build telemetry, collection episodes, Jira repairs, and technician workloads.
OIDC single sign-on and certificate-authenticated egress.
Covered by 296 automated tests.
A daily fleet-health report in Python and systemd. It pulls live Jira issues, dedupes tickets, and tracks active and blocked repairs.

projects.title: Humanoid Teleoperation
projects.summary: Piloted humanoid robots to collect the demonstrations their models train on.
highlights: Teleoperated humanoids with Foxglove and Manus to collect training demonstrations.
Monitored actuator health, runtime faults, and system logs.
Annotated and quality-checked demonstration data with engineering teams to support model and policy updates.

engineeringProjects.title: SO-101 Teleoperation Research
engineeringProjects.summary: Comparing VR teleoperation (Meta Quest with BEAVR) against leader-arm teleoperation on SO-101 arms. The question is how each one affects demonstration quality and downstream ACT policy performance.
highlights: Leader-follower teleoperation and RealSense capture for recording demonstrations.
LeRobot datasets, policy training and evaluation, and MuJoCo simulation.
Trained ACT and MLP behavior-cloning policies.
Fail-closed motor control: exclusive bus leases, deadman and watchdog supervision, latched stops that need manual clearance, and HIL safety gates.

engineeringProjects.title: WRAM: Wildfire Risk Assessment Model
engineeringProjects.summary: A TensorFlow U-Net trained on 12-band Sentinel-2 satellite imagery to find wildfire-risk zones.
highlights: Validated against Cal Fire ground-truth data.
Trained with data augmentation and dropout.
Took 2nd place at the ACM AI Hackathon.

engineeringProjects.title: SentrySight
engineeringProjects.summary: AI firearm detection with computer vision, plus an interactive web interface for exploring detections and alerts.

engineeringProjects.title: Blockchain Certificate System DApp
engineeringProjects.summary: Issues and revokes academic certificates on-chain with Solidity. Stores document hashes on IPFS. Anyone can verify a certificate in the React app.
highlights: Verification works without a central authority.
Diagnosed and resolved 500+ Jira-tracked engineering issues across six humanoid and robotic manipulation programs, from hardware and firmware to embedded systems and teleoperation software.
Led the production control app for a wearable UMI humanoid teleoperation suit, from implementation through deployment.
Built a Next.js and React fleet dashboard with OIDC SSO, certificate-authenticated egress, and 296 automated tests.
Automated daily fleet-health reporting with Python and systemd.
Operated humanoid robots with teleoperation, Foxglove, and Manus to collect training demonstrations.
Monitored actuator health, runtime faults, and system logs.
Annotated and quality-checked demonstration data with engineering teams to support model and policy updates.
Performed vulnerability scans, network-traffic analysis, compliance documentation, and workflow digitization.
Scoped, developed, and delivered web and media projects for client businesses.

about: I'm a robotics software engineer at Sigma Design @ Meta Reality Labs. I build operator interfaces, fleet tooling, and hardware-software integrations for humanoid and manipulation robots.

My work runs from React and TypeScript frontends to Python services, Embedded Linux, NVIDIA Jetson systems, EtherCAT networks, and camera pipelines. Before this I piloted humanoid robots at Figure AI and worked in cybersecurity at Cyber Proud / CalSTRS. I earned my B.S. in Computer Science from Sacramento State in May 2025.
On my own time I research teleoperation on SO-101 arms: how VR and leader-arm control affect demonstration quality, and the ACT policies trained on those demonstrations.
